# CANDIDATE: VWAP_CONT_VIX_HIGH_DTE

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The vwap_continuation signal performs better in elevated VIX regimes and at longer DTE. We hypothesize that filtering for VIX > 18 and DTE >= 2 (2DTE weekly options) will improve edge_capture by avoiding low-VIX loser days while preserving high-VIX winner days like 5/04.

## Mechanism

Entry: vwap_continuation signal fires (as defined in playbook) AND VIX > 18 AND DTE = 2 (using 2DTE weekly options at ITM-2 strike). Exit: chart-stop-primary (rejected level ± $0.50 buffer), TP1 at +50% premium (sell 2/3), runner with chandelier profit-lock (arms at +5%, trails 15%), 15:50 ET time stop. Contract size adjusted for 2DTE ITM-2 premium.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (based on 2DTE ITM-2 entry premium ~$0.80-$2.50)
2. **Sample bias:** Testing 30 combos across VIX thresholds (15,18,20,22,25,28) and DTE (1,2,3,4) using available OPRA cache. High overfit risk due to multiple testing; will apply FDR correction in Stage-2.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window pending Stage-1 completion)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J day validation pending OOS)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: missing 4/29/5/01 winners if VIX ≤18 (historical VIX: 4/29=16.2, 5/01=17.1 → both filtered out)
   - Max drawdown: potential -$1,200 if we miss two winner days and take losers
   - Blow-up scenario: whipsaw in high VIX/low liquidity causing repeated stops
6. **Concentration:** Will disclose top-5 days concentration post-backtest (expect high if 5/04 dominates)

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators (9/9 PASS), walk-forward OOS Sharpe ≥0.70, real-fills on top 3 J days showing no winner regression and improved loss avoidance, OOS exp/tr > baseline vwap_continuation.

4 / 10 -- based on VIX regime sensitivity observed in lessons and DTE lift in WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE, but direct J-day impact unknown without backtest.
